stories.headline: Anthropic preparing to float on Nasdaq this week at a $1.4tn valuation
stories.quote: Anthropic is preparing to float on Nasdaq this week at a staggering $1.4tn valuation, in what could be one of the largest IPOs in history — and the first for a company built entirely around frontier AI models.
stories.description: Company built entirely around frontier AI models

facts.text: Planned Nasdaq listing this week at a $1.4tn valuation
facts.quote: Anthropic is preparing to float on Nasdaq this week at a staggering $1.4tn valuation

facts.text: Company is spending heavily on computing infrastructure despite revenue growth
facts.quote: Despite Anthropic's extraordinary revenue growth, the company is burning through eye-watering sums on computing infrastructure.

facts.text: Some investors fear the listing could trigger a wider correction
facts.quote: And with AI stocks already showing signs of volatility, some investors fear the listing could trigger a wider correction.

stories.headline: Isomorphic Labs raised $5bn, backed by Sequoia and A16z
stories.quote: Isomorphic Labs raised $5bn in fresh funding , backed by Sequoia and A16z.

stories.headline: The Family cofounder Oussama Ammar sentenced to 16 months in prison by a London court
stories.quote: Oussama Ammar, cofounder of French startup accelerator The Family, has been sentenced to 16 months in prison by a London court after breaching orders freezing his assets and making false statements about his finances.

stories.headline: Disseqt raised an $8m round backed by senior leaders at OpenAI and Meta
stories.quote: Exclusive: Disseqt, a London-based startup building governance structures for AI agents, has raised an $8m round backed by senior leaders at OpenAI and Meta.
stories.description: Building governance structures for AI agents

stories.headline: Humanoid startup Vesoma is seeking €50m
stories.quote: Exclusive: Humanoid startup Vesoma is seeking €50m amid continued investor fervour for companies building humanlike robots for industry applications.

stories.headline: Genesis AI raised a $500m Series A at a $3.5bn valuation
stories.quote: Genesis AI, which is building AI models designed to run across a wide range of robots, raised a $500m Series A at a $3.5bn valuation.
stories.description: Building AI models designed to run across a wide range of robots

stories.headline: Remanence raised a $30m seed round led by EQT Ventures and FirstMark
stories.quote: Paris-based Remanence, which turns AI agents' execution traces into specialised models whose weights the customer owns, raised $30m in seed funding. EQT Ventures and FirstMark led the round.
stories.description: Turns AI agents' execution traces into specialised models customers own
stories.founder_background: cofounded by a trio of H Company alumni

stories.headline: Model ML raised $250m Series B led by General Atlantic and QED Investors
stories.quote: London-based Model ML, which builds personal AI agents for bankers, consultants and investors, raised $250m in Series B funding. General Atlantic, QED Investors led the round
stories.description: Builds personal AI agents for bankers, consultants and investors

stories.headline: Tiberius Aerospace raised $85m Series A led by Lakestar and Rochefort Asset Management
stories.quote: London-based Tiberius Aerospace, which Develops precision-guided artillery ammunition and AI-powered defence manufacturing, raised $85m in Series A funding. Lakestar and Rochefort Asset Management led the round
stories.description: Develops precision-guided artillery ammunition and AI-powered defence manufacturing

stories.headline: Traitomic raised €20m Series A led by Sofinnova Partners
stories.quote: Copenhagen-based Traitomic, which develops technology to identify desirable traits in plants and microorganisms without genetic modification, raised €20m in Series A funding. Sofinnova Partners led the round
stories.description: Identifies desirable traits in plants and microorganisms without genetic modification

stories.headline: MatchWornShirt raised $20m led by Gamma Waves Partners
stories.quote: Amsterdam-based MatchWornShirt (MWS), which runs a marketplace and auction platform for authenticated game-worn sports memorabilia, raised $20m in funding. Gamma Waves Partners led the round
stories.description: Marketplace and auction platform for authenticated game-worn sports memorabilia
